articles.title: Romeo + Juliet at 30: how Baz Luhrmann made teens fall in love with Shakespeare
articles.summary: The maximalist, heart over head adaptation of the romantic tragedy made stars of its leads and became an English teacher’s most trusted weapon for Bard-averse students. Romeo + Juliet is not the most renowned or beloved of Shakespeare’s plays, but it is perhaps the most foundational.
body: As such, the blatantly youth-aimed film had plenty of detractors in its time. Critics dismissed it as vulgar and garish, but audiences turned out en masse; Romeo + Juliet made over $147m against a $14.5m budget, boosted in part by a period-defining soundtrack with needle drops from The Cardigans, Everclear, Radiohead and Garbage. (And of course, the song from that oft-replayed fish tank scene, Des’ree’s I’m Kissing You, became the ubiquitous soundtrack for couple-shipping montage videos on 2000s YouTube). By the time I first viewed the film in 2009 – like many, in high school English class, as part of my teacher’s bid to get us invested in Shakespeare – it was already considered a classic.
points: The maximalist, heart over head adaptation of the romantic tragedy made stars of its leads and became an English teacher’s most trusted weapon for Bard-averse students.

We jump six years into the future, and Navarrette’s lonely widow is finally ready to date. She matches with a nice-looking man named Tom Oakland (played by Ben Marshall) on a dating app, and the two go out on a romantic date. They seem to click, and she takes him back to her apartment for a nightcap to meet PD — when, all of a sudden, PD transforms into a giant, menacing killer robot, rips Tom’s penis off and hurls it into the moon.
“PD stands for Penis Destroyer?!” exclaims Navarrette’s widow, before the robot shoots Tom with a laser beam until he explodes, covering her in blood.
“He did love me… My husband loved me after all!” says the delighted woman.

articles.title: ‘Godzilla Minus Zero’ Stars Relive Hollywood Ovation and Fan Chants for Yamazaki Takashi at Tokyo Festival
articles.summary: The cast of “Godzilla Minus Zero” brought the glow of a Hollywood standing ovation to the 39th Tokyo International Film Festival on Sunday, two days before Yamazaki Takashi’s follow-up to his Oscar-winning “Godzilla Minus One” opens in Japan.
body: “The energy was simply extraordinary,” Kamiki said. “Feeling that raw enthusiasm firsthand made me realize all over again just how deeply Godzilla is loved around the world. It was an invaluable experience.”

Applause in the 900-seat theater reportedly ran on without a break. Hamabe said the cast later met premiere-goers at an after-party, where many approached them with big smiles to share their reactions. Some had dressed in Godzilla-themed outfits or wore Godzilla badges.

The red carpet was open to passersby, Kamiki recalled. Some fans held up large posters and asked for autographs, while chants of the director’s first name broke out from the crowd. “It wasn’t just a polite ‘Takashi,’” he said. “It was like: ‘TAKASHI! HEY, TAKASHI!’ It was roaring.” When Yamazaki went over to sign autographs, the crowd erupted again, leaving Kamiki convinced that “Takashi of the world is truly amazing.”
The Tokyo event also marked the first stage appearance of child actor Nagatani Sae, who returns as Shikishima Akiko. Kamiki walked her onstage.

articles.title: ‘SNL’ Weekend Update Finally Weighs in on Israel
articles.summary: The Halloween edition of “SNL” Weekend Update saw a cameo by Ben Marshall’s Pennywise as well as some jabs at President Trump’s recent obsession with candidates’ posteriors. “Even Vice President JD Vance came out and said that he was jealous that President Trump has never complimented his butt.
body: Later on during Weekend Update, Michael Che made a joke about Israel that made Jost jokingly grimace.
“This week, a record number of people voted in Israel’s election — which is great to see, regardless of if you’re on the right side, or the left side, or the genocide,” quipped Che.

One of the reasons why the U.K.’s “Saturday Night Live” Weekend Update has lapped the U.S. version is that Jost and Che have largely avoided controversial topics like Israel, whereas the U.K.’s Weekend Update co-hosts have artfully mocked the likes of Ed Sheeran and Macklemore over their outsized roles in the conversation surrounding Israel’s war on Gaza.
And this, it seems, is the best Jost and Che could finally come up with.

articles.title: ‘SNL’ Celebrates Milwaukee Brewers’ World Series Win With Bobby Moynihan’s Drunk Uncle on Weekend Update
articles.summary: “Saturday Night Live” paid tribute to the Milwaukee Brewers’ historic World Series win during a Weekend Update segment that featured the return of Bobby Moynihan’s Drunk Uncle commentator character. Moynihan spent nine seasons on “SNL,” from 2009 to 2017.
body: This time around, Drunk Uncle hailed the Brewers’ first World Series victory in the nearly 60-year history of the team as a win attributed to the power of suds in a town that is synonymous with beer — hence the team’s name.

In classic fashion, Drunk Uncle told “Weekend Update” anchors Colin Jost and Michael Che that he was happy for the Brewers but deeply concerned about the state of baseball overall. After recent rule changes, the duration of most baseball games as tightened up, something that Drunk Uncle lamented. Instead of running seven hours, “the game ends in 20 minutes and everybody goes home to watch their gay hockey shows,” Moynihan as Drunk Uncle said in a nod to “Heated Rivalry.”

As usual, Drunk Uncle got progressively more emotional as the segment went on, tossing out one-liners about Elizabeth Holmes (“I believe her”) and “Helen of Troy was white,” in a nod to the ongoing angry debate in some circles about the casting of historical characters in period movies and TV shows.
But just as Drunk Uncle began to wallow, he was surprised by the appearance of two Brewers players, slugger Christian Yelich and second baseman Brice Turang, and the team’s manager, Pat Murphy.
points: “Saturday Night Live” paid tribute to the Milwaukee Brewers’ historic World Series win during a Weekend Update segment that featured the return of Bobby Moynihan’s Drunk Uncle commentator character.

articles.title: ‘Godzilla Minus Zero’ Crashes Into Tokyo Film Festival With Stars Ryunosuke Kamiki, Minami Hamabe in Tow
articles.summary: Takashi Yamazaki’s sequel brought costumed fans, monster figurines and rapturous applause at two sold-out festival screenings ahead of its Nov. 3 Japanese release.
body: The King of Monsters finally stomped his way into Japan ’s largest celebration of cinema on Sunday as Takashi Yamazaki ’s wildly anticipated Godzilla Minus Zero played to a packed pair of screenings at the Tokyo International Film Festival.

Godzilla Minus Zero is playing as the “centerpiece film” of the Tokyo festival’s programming this year, and it undoubtedly brought a welcome jolt of energy to the event as it moves through its second half. When the credits rolled on the second screening inside Hulic Hall Tokyo, the crowd erupted into uncharacteristically rapturous applause, with the always respectful but typically subdued Japanese festivalgoers all smiles and excited chatter over favorite monster moments as they poured into the autumn evening in Tokyo’s Ginza district — where much of the carnage on screen takes place.

articles.title: CBS' Hit Crime Procedural Officially Reaches a Massive Viewership Milestone
articles.summary: Most shows launch with strong viewership, but as seasons progress, much of that viewership erodes, leaving a core fandom. If that core viewership is big enough, as seen with shows like NCIS, then the show survives year in, year out. That model has sustained television for the longest time.
body: It launched last season with decent viewership, averaging 7 million viewers per week, with streaming accounting for most of those viewers. The law enforcement drama also performed well with critics, managing a 75% on Rotten Tomatoes. Critics and viewers lauded its grounded storytelling and the chemistry between the main characters. Sheriff Country also proved to be a good investment for CBS because it improved the Friday 8 pm slot previously occupied by S.W.A.T. The network reported a 33% increase in viewership. The show was renewed for a second season that premiered in October, marking the return of the Morena Baccarin -led Fire Country spin-off.

Recent Nielsen ratings show that Sheriff Country has continued to grow heading into Season 2. The premiere episode drew 10.52 million viewers in its first week, a 27% increase from the Season 1 premiere. This episode also marked the show's most-watched episode ever. CBS is having a better season, with overall viewership up 14%. Sheriff Country becomes the only show this season to jump from single digits to double digits, entering the coveted 10 Million Club on CBS.

If that core viewership is big enough, as seen with shows like NCIS, then the show survives year in, year out.

articles.title: 10 Great Adventure Video Games You Haven't Played
articles.summary: Video games have dozens of genres for fans to enjoy, but one of the most popular is adventure. After all, there are few things players love more than setting out on grand journeys to conquer a great foe or simply explore a fascinating world.
body: Adventures are supposed to be memorable, which is why these popular games are so well known, but a world lies in wait that gamers haven't touched. That is why this list will highlight ten great adventure video games that you likely haven’t played. Based on aspects such as obscurity compared to quality, originality, sense of adventure, design, gameplay, entertainment value, and overall quality, all of these games should now be on your wishlist.

A good adventure takes a lot of aspects, including mystery, which is why a game like Shadow of Memories is so good. Set in a fictitious German town, Eike is given a strange device after being stabbed to death, which allows him to travel through time to prevent his murder. However, it isn’t so simple, with him needing to go between different historical eras to alter events involving the townspeople and his ancestors.

articles.title: Gary Oldman’s 6-Part Spy Thriller Officially Takes Apple TV’s No. 1 Spot
articles.summary: Gary Oldman is probably your father-in-law's favorite actor by this stage. A man who was the bad guy in countless movies throughout the 1990s and 2000s, and who is now officially the world's most repugnant yet effective spy thanks to a winning combination of remarkable intelligence and flatulence.
body: Slow Horses is continuing to dominate Apple TV's streaming charts, just as its latest acclaimed season continues to wow viewers. Based on Mick Herron 's bestselling novels, Slow Horses follows a group of MI5 agents assigned to Slough House, a miserable office where intelligence officers are sent after making career-ending mistakes, but these folks are almost too competent to fail where they're expected to. Season 6 sees the Slow Horses on the run as Diana Taverner embroils them all in a fatally high-stakes game of retaliation and revenge.

The cast is led by Oldman ( Darkest Hour ) as Jackson Lamb, alongside Jack Lowden ( Dunkirk ) as River Cartwright, Kristin Scott Thomas ( Darkest Hour ) as Diana Taverner, Saskia Reeves ( Luther ) as Catherine Standish, Rosalind Eleazar ( Missing You ) as Louisa Guy, Christopher Chung ( Waterloo Road ) as Roddy Ho and Aimee-Ffion Edwards ( Peaky Blinders ) as Shirley Dander.
